metadata.methods_description: MEG and EMG were recorded on a CTF-275 system at 600 Hz in a magnetically shielded room, with head position tracked by three localization coils. T1-weighted MPRAGE MRI was acquired at 3T. Behavior was recorded with E-Prime 2 and a Cedrus four-key response pad. Eye gaze and pupil data were acquired with an EyeLink 1000 Plus. Participants typed a trained 5-item sequence (4-1-3-2-4) in 10 s trials interleaved with 10 s rest breaks, and were retested on the trained sequence and on untrained control sequences.
